title: PR claims cap-8 run grows estates to 8 'before seeding a new area' but the artifact shows no SEED
evidence:
+**The one-line cap change, demonstrated** (`max_members: 8` in balance.json,
+`spawn-audit-after-cap8.txt`): the same seed run grows estates to **8**
+members before seeding a new area — the cap is a data knob, one line.
+  spawn #01 slot 03 ATTCH @ [13, 15]  nearest-earlier 5.00 tiles
+  spawn #11 slot 13 ATTCH @ [23, 20]  nearest-earlier 5.00 tiles
detail: The cap-8 audit footer lists 11 spawns, all ATTCH, zero SEED — the cap-to-seed transition is never demonstrated in the evidence; only the seed-9 unit test covers it.
recommended_fix: Extend the cap-8 capture past the first post-cap seed, or soften the PR sentence to claim only 'grows estates to 8'.
